ingredientSections.heading: Filling
items: 1 packet Vegan Pudding & Pie Filling Powder Mix

methodSections.heading: Base
steps: Toast the sunflower seeds in a pan over a medium heat until lightly golden and fragrant. Remove the sunflower seeds from the pan, add the rolled oats and toast until lightly golden.
Add the toasted seeds and oats to a blender or food processor with the salt and pulse into an even crumble.

Transfer the seed and oat mixture into a large bowl and add the solid coconut oil, maple syrup, vanilla extract and half of the water. Mix all the ingredients together with a spatula until it starts to come together. Add the rest of the water. When this is mixed through it should have a tacky consistency.
Turn out the mixture into a pie tin. Smooth out and press down the mixture into the corners, evenly around the base and up the sides a bit. Place in the fridge to harden.

methodSections.heading: Filling
steps: Empty a packet of Vegan Pudding & Co. Pie Filling Powder Mix and the can of coconut milk into a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a saucepan and over medium heat and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and allow to cool.

methodSections.heading: Pie
steps: Pour the filling into the base, smooth it out and then return the pie to the fridge to set for about 2 hours. Don't put it in the freezer.
Serve with coconut whipped cream and cinnamon powder.
